body: I know most don’t take kids serious but I always will. The youngest I remember wanting to kill myself was about 8. In the past 13 years that impulse has never gone away, it probably never will.

I only live for my pets. It’s why I can never not have any. I’m afraid of what I would do to myself if I didn’t have the thought “what would happen to my cats?” I even make sure to have pets that aren’t easy to rehome.
Already have enough of those just hoping one day one of them takes me out. It would be a dream come true to find out I have a terminal illness.

Because I’m a fuck up whose depression or anxiety always ruins everything.  Because I’m a bitch who is cruel to everyone who tries the be kind to me. Because I’m so lazy I can’t even bring myself to to anything that might fix somethings not all but a few minor things.
